description: Somos el equipo Nostos, un grupo multidisciplinario apasionado por la tecnología y la exploración espacial.
summary: NOSTOS is a web application designed to comprehensively monitor the physical and psychological health of crew members during long-duration space missions, whether aboard orbital stations or at future exploration bases on Mars.
details:
How It Works

NOSTOS is an educational web application that simulates health monitoring for a crew of three astronauts. The main dashboard displays their health metrics, trends, and status. Each astronaut’s profile provides detailed data organized by system, along with historical charts.

The app also lets users record psychological well-being check-ins, review alerts and recommendations, and generate reports for the past 24 hours, one week, or one month. Rest, EVA/physical activity, and emergency scenarios generate simulated data to demonstrate how the system responds. Alerts and reports support monitoring but do not replace medical evaluation. Reports for the medical team on Earth must be downloaded and delivered separately.

Technologies Used

  • Python: core application logic.
  • Streamlit: web interface, controls, cards, dialogs, and reports.
  • Pandas: organizes and analyzes readings and history.
  • Plotly: interactive trend charts.
  • NumPy: generates and manages simulated data.
  • Git and GitHub: version control and code hosting.
  • Streamlit Community Cloud: web app deployment.
